name: Top Smoke Pre-Roll Pack | Gelato #33
description: Gelato #33, also known as Larry Bird, is an indica dominant hybrid made by crossing Sunset Sherbet x Thin Mint GSC. This strain offers an uplifting and energetic high that is perfect for any post-work activity after a long day. 28 one gram pre-rolls.
